detail.longDescription: The # selfhosting journey continues. When I setup my # linux server, I went with # docker Desktop. I am now ready to migrate to the Docker engine. Aside from a few less than helpful Reddit posts, I am not finding any guides on doing this. Everything is built using docker compose, so that should help. It seems like the path is Backup my containers > Uninstall Docker desktop > Install docker engine > import containers. Does this seem right? It sure would be nice if there was an easy migration utility.
